opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: Offers up to £500,000; in special cases up to £750,000; most grants below £300,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations/institutions. Not individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with the hosting institution; not projects led by unaffiliated individuals, schools/FE colleges, undergraduates or master's students; not PhD fees.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five priority questions from its Strategic Review and aim to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines a year (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK applicants; encourages applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities; partnership applications encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society. 2026 priority theme: inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK. One deadline a year (Autumn).

opportunities.title: Strategic Fund

amount.raw: Up to £15 million available; major grants typically in the range of £1-3 million each

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based; not individuals without formal employment or relationship with hosting institution; not unaffiliated individuals, undergraduates or master's students; not PhD fees.
opportunities.summary: Research grants for original and ambitious, transformative projects that confront the scale and urgency of the UK's biggest social and economic challenges, addressing one or more of the five priority questions. Multidisciplinary and innovative approaches encouraged.
